clinical_trials.brief_summary: Multicentric, international, web-based prospective documentation of the indications and results of Pressurized Aerosol Chemotherapy (so-called PIPAC or PITAC) for treating malignant pleural and peritoneal diseases. Indication is decided by the treating physician. There are no predefined inclusion or exclusion criteria.

literature.title: Ovarian metastasis following gallbladder carcinoma: a case report.
literature.abstract: Mucinous ovarian cancer raises problems of differential diagnoses because it is often difficult to distinguish the primary from the metastatic form. Most metastatic ovarian tumors originate from the gastrointestinal tract, mainly colorectal, gastric, pancreatic; the gallbladder is a very rare source of ovarian metastases.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: ⚠️ 重要背景：Gemcitabine+Cisplatin 為膽道癌（含膽囊癌）之全球標準一線化療（ABC-02 Phase 3 RCT，n=410，Valle et al.），但此關鍵試驗未納入本資料集，且未區分黏液亞型。黏液腺癌因緻密黏液基質可能形成藥物滲透屏障，需亞型專屬研究確認療效。現有資料集中 3 篇文獻均為個案報告等級（其中 2 篇為胰臟相關），證據等級低，但母病種（膽囊腺癌）有 L1 基礎，故建議列為研究問題而非完全排除。
卵巢網腺癌（Rete ovarii adenocarcinoma）為極罕見婦科惡性腫瘤（全球個案報告不足百例），無標準化療方案。TxGNN 基於知識圖譜結構相似性預測高分，但無任何 Gemcitabine 相關臨床或文獻資料，停留於純計算預測階段。
富含黏液之子宮內膜樣腺癌為高分化稀有形態學亞型，預後通常良好，化療適應症罕見。無任何 Gemcitabine 相關臨床試驗或文獻。若需化療，可借鑑 endometrial mucinous adenocarcinoma 之 L3 間接證據，但現階段本亞型獨立判斷僅為 L5。
